expected.text: Get prior express consent from each recipient before sending any message.
expected.quote: Prior to sending any messages via the Twilio Messaging Services, as further described below, you must obtain prior express consent from the message recipient

expected.text: Keep proof of each consent until the recipient withdraws it, and give it to Twilio on request.
expected.quote: You are required to retain proof of all consents obtained from recipients for as long as needed to meet your legal requirements and at least until a recipient withdraws their consent.

expected.text: The first message to a recipient must say Reply STOP to unsubscribe, or use another standard opt-out keyword.
expected.quote: The initial message that you send to a recipient needs to include the following language

expected.text: After a recipient opts out, send no further messages except one confirmation.
expected.quote: When a recipient revokes their previously provided consent, also known as an opt-out, you may deliver one final message to confirm that the revocation of their prior consent or opt-out has been processed, but any subsequent messages are prohibited.

expected.text: Keep the opt-out process straightforward, easy to reach, and one step.
expected.quote: The opt-out process must be straightforward and easily accessible, requiring a single step to complete.

expected.text: A conversational reply to us is not consent for ongoing recurring messages.
expected.quote: This conversational engagement does not provide you necessary consent to engage in ongoing recurring engagement with that individual.
expected.section: Consent for Messages Initiated by an Individual to You

expected.text: If our product's users send messages through us, require them to get express written consent from downstream users.
expected.quote: you must require those End Users and customers to obtain prior express written consent from any downstream users of your software application or service.
expected.section: Consent from Your End Users or Customers
